requirements.text: The system must allow users to color-code modules for easier identification.
The system must provide an option to hide canceled classes in the timetable.
The system must enable users to add personal study times to the timetable.
The system must send push notifications or emails as soon as grades are posted, ideally within a few minutes.
The system must provide a simple feedback form for modules that includes a rating system and an optional comment box.
All enhancements must integrate smoothly with the existing portal infrastructure without affecting performance.
